text.BATTLE_LOADING_2: Law and order are made by the strong so I'll be the law.
text.BATTLE_LOADING_3: A classroom with bright and clear windows. This is a place that not only brings joy to the girls; it is also where troubles disappear.
text.BATTLE_LOADING_4: As long as I know the truth I will not be afraid even if I enter the dark.
text.BATTLE_LOADING_5: You are your own worst enemy! Conquer yourself and grow!
text.BATTLE_LOADING_6: Gentleness won't overcome evil. Good must be stronger than evil.
text.BATTLE_LOADING_7: This magnificent hall is where all important meetings happen on campus.
text.BATTLE_LOADING_8: The fireworks show is the highlight of the summer festival.
text.BATTLE_LOADING_9: Everyone is looking forward to the annual School Festival. What will the Girls perform this year? Let's find out!
text.BATTLE_LOADING_10: What I value is not strength but belief. Only with firm beliefs can one become strong.
text.BATTLE_TIPS_DESC3: Won't be affected by Faction Rivalry
